messages:
ciara: Quick noteQA found a ~0.6% NDCG drop on reranker when switching model-c to INT8, concentrated on short candidate lists (<=5).
raj: That's small but could flip top-1. FP32 vs INT8 replay shows systematic shifts, not random.
leila: Likely compression in final logits after requant. Single-scale INT8 can reduce dynamic range between close candidates.
max: Do we have reconstruction stats for the final linear?
ciara: Sample export: output_fp32 min=-6.2 max=8.9 mean=0.23 std=1.37; int8 scale=0.283; KL=0.012 MAE=0.09.
raj: Even small KL can matter for ranking near-tied logits.
leila: Short-term mitigations: (A) per-endpoint softmax_scale postproc (multiply logits by s) (B) tiny bias correction vector in requant metadata. Both low perf cost.
max: I like (A) as an emergency patch; must be gated and canaried. Also add automated calibration to compute s per model variant.
olivia: We'll need to notify affected customers and shadow test before enabling.
deploybot: deploybot: Created canary RERANK-INT8-CALIB-2026-09-21 (shadow mode).
ciara: I tested s=1.08 locally, recovered ~0.55% NDCG on our eval set. Good sign.
leila: Proposed artifacts: calibration table {model_variant -> softmax_scale, kl_reduction, sample_count, created_at, encrypted_path}. Keep in object store with encryption + TTL.
max: Calibration job: daily run, N=10k sample queries, compute optimal s via gridsearch minimizing pairwise swap metric. Write table to encrypted bucket.
raj: UX: endpoint config flags quant_rerank_enabled (bool), softmax_scale_override (optional float), prefer_int8_for_rerank (bool). Default hosted: prefer_int8_for_rerank=false until stable. Dedicated unchanged.
leila: Tests: unit test topK stability tolerance, adversarial tied-logit case, integration smoke comparing NDCG_f32 vs NDCG_int8_scaled.
ciara: Action items: 1) Leila: sketch schema + prototype softmax_scale postproc. 2) Max: calibration job + unit tests. 3) Raj: endpoint config UX + storage policy. 4) Olivia: customer comms if canary flags customers.
max: I'll add canary dashboard metrics: NDCG_f32, NDCG_int8_raw, NDCG_int8_scaled, rerank_delta. Fail if scaled doesn't cut delta by >=50%.
leila: Long-term: consider per-channel / sign-preserving requant for final linear to avoid heuristic scaling. Put in quant-engine backlog.
ciara: Thanks all. I'll open a short RFC-lite with numbers and rollout plan.
raj: Thanks :thumbsup:
